392	        *,
393	        concurrency: int | None = None,
394	    ) -> list[LlmResult | Exception]:
395	        """Run many requests: cache lookups and logging in this thread, provider calls in a pool."""
396	        concurrency = concurrency or self.settings.llm_concurrency
397	        results: list[LlmResult | Exception | None] = [None] * len(requests)
398	        todo: list[tuple[int, LlmRequest, str, dict[str, Any] | None, str]] = []
399	        for i, req in enumerate(requests):
400	            try:
401	                model = self.resolve_model(req)
402	                schema = to_strict_schema(schema_model) if schema_model is not None else None
403	                ihash = self.input_hash(req, model, schema)
404	                hit = self.cached_call(ihash)
405	                if hit is not None and hit.response:
406	                    results[i] = LlmResult(
407	                        parsed=self._parse(hit.response["text"], schema_model),
408	                        text=hit.response["text"],
409	                        model=hit.model,
410	                        input_tokens=hit.input_tokens,
411	                        cached_tokens=hit.cached_tokens,
412	                        output_tokens=hit.output_tokens,
413	                        cost_estimate_usd=hit.cost_estimate_usd,
414	                        cached=True,
415	                        llm_call_id=hit.id,
416	                        input_hash=ihash,
417	                    )
418	                else:
419	                    todo.append((i, req, model, schema, ihash))
420	            except LlmError as exc:
421	                results[i] = exc
422	
423	        def work(
424	            item: tuple[int, LlmRequest, str, dict[str, Any] | None, str],
425	        ) -> tuple[int, ProviderResponse | Exception]:
426	            i, req, model, schema, _ = item
427	            try:
428	                return i, self._call_with_retries(req, model, schema, None)
429	            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - surfaced per item
430	                return i, exc
431	
432	        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max(1, concurrency)) as pool:
433	            responses = list(pool.map(work, todo))
434	        by_index = {i: r for i, r in responses}
435	        for i, req, model, _schema, ihash in todo:
436	            resp = by_index[i]
437	            if isinstance(resp, Exception):
438	                self._record(
439	                    req,
440	                    model,
441	                    ihash,
442	                    None,
443	                    status="error",
444	                    error=str(resp)[:2000],
445	                    latency_ms=0,
446	                    attempts=self.settings.llm_max_attempts,
447	                )
448	                results[i] = resp if isinstance(resp, LlmError) else LlmError(str(resp))
449	                continue
450	            try:
451	                parsed = self._parse(resp.text, schema_model)
452	            except LlmSchemaError as exc:
453	                self._record(
454	                    req,
455	                    model,
456	                    ihash,
457	                    resp,
458	                    status="error",
459	                    error=str(exc),
460	                    latency_ms=int(resp.__dict__.get("_latency_ms", 0)),
461	                    attempts=1,
462	                )
463	                results[i] = exc
464	                continue
465	            row = self._record(
466	                req,
467	                model,
468	                ihash,
469	                resp,
470	                status="ok",
471	                error=None,
472	                latency_ms=int(resp.__dict__.get("_latency_ms", 0)),
473	                attempts=1,
474	            )
475	            results[i] = LlmResult(
476	                parsed=parsed,
477	                text=resp.text,
478	                model=resp.model,
479	                input_tokens=resp.input_tokens,
480	                cached_tokens=resp.cached_tokens,
481	                output_tokens=resp.output_tokens,
482	                cost_estimate_usd=row.cost_estimate_usd,
483	                cached=False,
484	                llm_call_id=row.id,
485	                input_hash=ihash,
486	            )
487	        return [r if r is not None else LlmError("unprocessed request") for r in results]
488	
489	    # ---- internals ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
490	
491	    def _call_with_retries(
492	        self, req: LlmRequest, model: str, schema: dict[str, Any] | None, ihash: str | None
493	    ) -> ProviderResponse:
494	        cap = self.settings.llm_max_cost_usd_per_run
495	        if cap and self.run_spent_usd() >= cap:
496	            raise LlmBudgetExceeded(f"run cost cap of USD {cap} reached")
497	        temperature = (
498	            req.temperature if req.temperature is not None else self.settings.llm_temperature
499	        )
500	        last_error: Exception | None = None
501	        for attempt in range(1, self.settings.llm_max_attempts + 1):
502	            started = time.monotonic()
503	            try:
504	                resp = self.provider.complete(
505	                    model=model,
506	                    system=req.system,
507	                    user=req.user,
508	                    schema=schema,
509	                    schema_name=req.schema_name,
510	                    temperature=temperature,
511	                    max_output_tokens=req.max_output_tokens,
512	                    timeout=self.settings.llm_timeout_seconds,
513	                )
514	                resp.__dict__["_latency_ms"] = int((time.monotonic() - started) * 1000)
515	                if resp.finish_reason == "length":
516	                    raise LlmError("provider answer truncated (max_output_tokens too small)")
517	                return resp
518	            except LlmRetryableError as exc:
519	                last_error = exc
520	                time.sleep(min(30.0, 2.0**attempt))
521	        raise LlmError(
522	            f"provider failed after {self.settings.llm_max_attempts} attempts: {last_error}"
523	        )

"""Provider-agnostic LLM gateway.

Responsibilities: one place for provider calls (OpenAI first), structured JSON outputs validated
against Pydantic models, a response cache keyed by the input hash (identical requests never hit
the provider twice), retries with backoff, per-call logging in ``llm_call`` with tokens and cost,
and a cost cap per run. Business modules never import a provider SDK directly.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import re
import time
from collections.abc import Callable
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any, Protocol, TypeVar

from pydantic import BaseModel, ValidationError
from sqlalchemy import func, select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from tracepoint.core.settings import Settings, get_settings
from tracepoint.db.models import LlmCall
from tracepoint.llm.pricing import estimate_cost_usd
from tracepoint.llm.schema import to_strict_schema

T = TypeVar("T", bound=BaseModel)


class LlmError(RuntimeError):
    """Base class for gateway errors."""


class LlmRetryableError(LlmError):
    """Transient provider error (rate limit, timeout, 5xx)."""


class LlmBudgetExceeded(LlmError):
    """The cost cap of the current run would be exceeded."""


class LlmSchemaError(LlmError):
    """The provider answer did not validate against the requested schema."""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class LlmRequest:
    purpose: str
    system: str
    user: str
    prompt_version: str
    schema_name: str = "result"
    tier: str = "bulk"  # bulk / reasoning → settings model
    model: str | None = None
    temperature: float | None = None
    max_output_tokens: int = 1024
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)


@dataclass
class ProviderResponse:
    text: str
    model: str
    input_tokens: int | None = None
    cached_tokens: int | None = None
    output_tokens: int | None = None
    finish_reason: str | None = None


@dataclass
class LlmResult:
    parsed: Any
    text: str
    model: str
    input_tokens: int | None
    cached_tokens: int | None
    output_tokens: int | None
    cost_estimate_usd: float | None
    cached: bool
    llm_call_id: int | None
    input_hash: str


class Provider(Protocol):
    name: str

    def complete(
        self,
        *,
        model: str,
        system: str,
        user: str,
        schema: dict[str, Any] | None,
        schema_name: str,
        temperature: float,
        max_output_tokens: int,
        timeout: float,
    ) -> ProviderResponse: ...


class OpenAIProvider:
    """OpenAI chat completions with JSON-schema structured outputs."""

    name = "openai"

    def __init__(self, api_key: str, base_url: str | None = None) -> None:
        from openai import OpenAI

        self._client = OpenAI(api_key=api_key, base_url=base_url)

    def complete(
        self,
        *,
        model: str,
        system: str,
        user: str,
        schema: dict[str, Any] | None,
        schema_name: str,
        temperature: float,
        max_output_tokens: int,
        timeout: float,
    ) -> ProviderResponse:
        import openai

        kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {
            "model": model,
            "messages": [{"role": "system", "content": system}, {"role": "user", "content": user}],
            "max_completion_tokens": max_output_tokens,
            "timeout": timeout,
        }
        if temperature is not None:
            kwargs["temperature"] = temperature
        if schema is not None:
            kwargs["response_format"] = {
                "type": "json_schema",
                "json_schema": {"name": schema_name, "schema": schema, "strict": True},
            }
        try:
            resp = self._client.chat.completions.create(**kwargs)
        except (openai.RateLimitError, openai.APITimeoutError, openai.APIConnectionError) as exc:
            raise LlmRetryableError(str(exc)) from exc
        except openai.APIStatusError as exc:
            if exc.status_code >= 500:
                raise LlmRetryableError(str(exc)) from exc
            raise LlmError(str(exc)) from exc
        choice = resp.choices[0]
        usage = getattr(resp, "usage", None)
        details = getattr(usage, "prompt_tokens_details", None) if usage else None
        return ProviderResponse(
            text=choice.message.content or "",
            model=getattr(resp, "model", model) or model,
            input_tokens=getattr(usage, "prompt_tokens", None) if usage else None,
            cached_tokens=getattr(details, "cached_tokens", None) if details else None,
            output_tokens=getattr(usage, "completion_tokens", None) if usage else None,
            finish_reason=getattr(choice, "finish_reason", None),
        )


class FakeProvider:
    """Deterministic provider for tests and dry runs. ``responder`` maps a request to JSON."""

    name = "fake"

    def __init__(
        self, responder: Callable[[dict[str, Any]], Any], model: str = "fake-model"
    ) -> None:
        self._responder = responder
        self.model = model
        self.calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    def complete(self, **kwargs: Any) -> ProviderResponse:
        self.calls.append(kwargs)
        payload = self._responder(kwargs)
        text = payload if isinstance(payload, str) else json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False)
        return ProviderResponse(
            text=text,
            model=self.model,
            input_tokens=len(kwargs.get("system", "")) // 4 + len(kwargs.get("user", "")) // 4,
            cached_tokens=0,
            output_tokens=len(text) // 4,
            finish_reason="stop",
        )


def make_provider(settings: Settings | None = None) -> Provider:
    settings = settings or get_settings()
    if settings.llm_provider == "openai":
        if not settings.openai_api_key:
            raise LlmError("TRACEPOINT_OPENAI_API_KEY is not set; use --dry-run or a FakeProvider")
        # An empty TRACEPOINT_OPENAI_BASE_URL= line in .env arrives as "", which the client
        # would take literally; treat it as unset.
        return OpenAIProvider(settings.openai_api_key, settings.openai_base_url or None)
    raise LlmError(f"unknown LLM provider {settings.llm_provider!r}")


_fence_re = re.compile(r"^```(?:json)?\s*|\s*```$", re.MULTILINE)


def _strip_fences(text: str) -> str:
    return _fence_re.sub("", text.strip()).strip()


class LlmGateway:
    def __init__(
        self,
        session: Session,
        provider: Provider,
        run_id: str | None,
        settings: Settings | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.session = session
        self.provider = provider
        self.run_id = run_id
        self.settings = settings or get_settings()
        self.spent_usd = 0.0

    # ---- helpers ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def resolve_model(self, req: LlmRequest) -> str:
        if req.model:
            return req.model
        if req.tier == "bulk" and self.settings.openai_model_bulk:
            return self.settings.openai_model_bulk
        if isinstance(self.provider, FakeProvider):
            return self.provider.model
        if not self.settings.openai_model:
            raise LlmError(
                "no model configured (TRACEPOINT_OPENAI_MODEL / TRACEPOINT_OPENAI_MODEL_BULK)"
            )
        return self.settings.openai_model

    def input_hash(self, req: LlmRequest, model: str, schema: dict[str, Any] | None) -> str:
        payload = {
            "provider": self.provider.name,
            "model": model,
            "prompt_version": req.prompt_version,
            "system": req.system,
            "user": req.user,
            "schema": schema,
            "temperature": req.temperature
            if req.temperature is not None
            else self.settings.llm_temperature,
        }
        return hashlib.sha256(
            json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
        ).hexdigest()

    def cached_call(self, input_hash: str) -> LlmCall | None:
        return self.session.scalar(
            select(LlmCall)
            .where(LlmCall.input_hash == input_hash, LlmCall.status == "ok")
            .order_by(LlmCall.id.desc())
        )

    def run_spent_usd(self) -> float:
        if self.run_id is None:
            return self.spent_usd
        total = self.session.scalar(
            select(func.coalesce(func.sum(LlmCall.cost_estimate_usd), 0.0)).where(
                LlmCall.run_id == self.run_id
            )
        )
        return float(total or 0.0)

    def _parse(self, text: str, schema_model: type[T] | None) -> Any:
        clean = _strip_fences(text)
        if schema_model is None:
            return clean
        try:
            return schema_model.model_validate_json(clean)
        except ValidationError as exc:
            raise LlmSchemaError(str(exc)[:1500]) from exc

    def _record(
        self,
        req: LlmRequest,
        model: str,
        input_hash: str,
        resp: ProviderResponse | None,
        *,
        status: str,
        error: str | None,
        latency_ms: int,
        attempts: int,
    ) -> LlmCall:
        cost = (
            estimate_cost_usd(resp.model, resp.input_tokens, resp.cached_tokens, resp.output_tokens)
            if resp is not None
            else None
        )
        row = LlmCall(
            run_id=self.run_id,
            purpose=req.purpose,
            provider=self.provider.name,
            model=resp.model if resp else model,
            prompt_version=req.prompt_version,
            input_hash=input_hash,
            input_tokens=resp.input_tokens if resp else None,
            cached_tokens=resp.cached_tokens if resp else None,
            output_tokens=resp.output_tokens if resp else None,
            cost_estimate_usd=cost,
            request={
                "system": req.system,
                "user": req.user,
                "schema_name": req.schema_name,
                "metadata": req.metadata,
            },
            response={"text": resp.text, "finish_reason": resp.finish_reason} if resp else None,
            status=status,
            error=error,
            latency_ms=latency_ms,
            attempts=attempts,
            created_at=datetime.now(UTC),
        )
        self.session.add(row)
        self.session.flush()
        if cost:
            self.spent_usd += cost
        return row

    # ---- public API ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def complete(
        self, req: LlmRequest, schema_model: type[T] | None = None, *, use_cache: bool = True
    ) -> LlmResult:
        model = self.resolve_model(req)
        schema = to_strict_schema(schema_model) if schema_model is not None else None
        ihash = self.input_hash(req, model, schema)
        if use_cache:
            hit = self.cached_call(ihash)
            if hit is not None and hit.response:
                return LlmResult(
                    parsed=self._parse(hit.response["text"], schema_model),
                    text=hit.response["text"],
                    model=hit.model,
                    input_tokens=hit.input_tokens,
                    cached_tokens=hit.cached_tokens,
                    output_tokens=hit.output_tokens,
                    cost_estimate_usd=hit.cost_estimate_usd,
                    cached=True,
                    llm_call_id=hit.id,
                    input_hash=ihash,
                )
        resp = self._call_with_retries(req, model, schema, ihash)
        parsed = None
        attempts_total = 1
        try:
            parsed = self._parse(resp.text, schema_model)
        except LlmSchemaError as exc:
            # one repair attempt with the validation error appended to the user message
            repair = LlmRequest(
                **{
                    **req.__dict__,
                    "user": req.user
                    + f"\n\nThe previous answer was not valid for the schema ({exc}). Return only valid JSON for the schema.",
                }
            )
            resp = self._call_with_retries(repair, model, schema, ihash)
            parsed = self._parse(resp.text, schema_model)
            attempts_total = 2
        latency = int(resp.__dict__.get("_latency_ms", 0))
        row = self._record(
            req,
            model,
            ihash,
            resp,
            status="ok",
            error=None,
            latency_ms=latency,
            attempts=attempts_total,
        )
        return LlmResult(
            parsed=parsed,
            text=resp.text,
            model=resp.model,
            input_tokens=resp.input_tokens,
            cached_tokens=resp.cached_tokens,
            output_tokens=resp.output_tokens,
            cost_estimate_usd=row.cost_estimate_usd,
            cached=False,
            llm_call_id=row.id,
            input_hash=ihash,
        )

    def complete_many(
        self,
        requests: list[LlmRequest],
        schema_model: type[T] | None = None,
        *,
        concurrency: int | None = None,
    ) -> list[LlmResult | Exception]:
        """Run many requests: cache lookups and logging in this thread, provider calls in a pool."""
        concurrency = concurrency or self.settings.llm_concurrency
        results: list[LlmResult | Exception | None] = [None] * len(requests)
        todo: list[tuple[int, LlmRequest, str, dict[str, Any] | None, str]] = []
        for i, req in enumerate(requests):
            try:
                model = self.resolve_model(req)
                schema = to_strict_schema(schema_model) if schema_model is not None else None
                ihash = self.input_hash(req, model, schema)
                hit = self.cached_call(ihash)
                if hit is not None and hit.response:
                    results[i] = LlmResult(
                        parsed=self._parse(hit.response["text"], schema_model),
                        text=hit.response["text"],
                        model=hit.model,
                        input_tokens=hit.input_tokens,
                        cached_tokens=hit.cached_tokens,
                        output_tokens=hit.output_tokens,
                        cost_estimate_usd=hit.cost_estimate_usd,
                        cached=True,
                        llm_call_id=hit.id,
                        input_hash=ihash,
                    )
                else:
                    todo.append((i, req, model, schema, ihash))
            except LlmError as exc:
                results[i] = exc

        def work(
            item: tuple[int, LlmRequest, str, dict[str, Any] | None, str],
        ) -> tuple[int, ProviderResponse | Exception]:
            i, req, model, schema, _ = item
            try:
                return i, self._call_with_retries(req, model, schema, None)
            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - surfaced per item
                return i, exc

        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max(1, concurrency)) as pool:
            responses = list(pool.map(work, todo))
        by_index = {i: r for i, r in responses}
        for i, req, model, _schema, ihash in todo:
            resp = by_index[i]
            if isinstance(resp, Exception):
                self._record(
                    req,
                    model,
                    ihash,
                    None,
                    status="error",
                    error=str(resp)[:2000],
                    latency_ms=0,
                    attempts=self.settings.llm_max_attempts,
                )
                results[i] = resp if isinstance(resp, LlmError) else LlmError(str(resp))
                continue
            try:
                parsed = self._parse(resp.text, schema_model)
            except LlmSchemaError as exc:
                self._record(
                    req,
                    model,
                    ihash,
                    resp,
                    status="error",
                    error=str(exc),
                    latency_ms=int(resp.__dict__.get("_latency_ms", 0)),
                    attempts=1,
                )
                results[i] = exc
                continue
            row = self._record(
                req,
                model,
                ihash,
                resp,
                status="ok",
                error=None,
                latency_ms=int(resp.__dict__.get("_latency_ms", 0)),
                attempts=1,
            )
            results[i] = LlmResult(
                parsed=parsed,
                text=resp.text,
                model=resp.model,
                input_tokens=resp.input_tokens,
                cached_tokens=resp.cached_tokens,
                output_tokens=resp.output_tokens,
                cost_estimate_usd=row.cost_estimate_usd,
                cached=False,
                llm_call_id=row.id,
                input_hash=ihash,
            )
        return [r if r is not None else LlmError("unprocessed request") for r in results]

    # ---- internals ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _call_with_retries(
        self, req: LlmRequest, model: str, schema: dict[str, Any] | None, ihash: str | None
    ) -> ProviderResponse:
        cap = self.settings.llm_max_cost_usd_per_run
        if cap and self.run_spent_usd() >= cap:
            raise LlmBudgetExceeded(f"run cost cap of USD {cap} reached")
        temperature = (
            req.temperature if req.temperature is not None else self.settings.llm_temperature
        )
        last_error: Exception | None = None
        for attempt in range(1, self.settings.llm_max_attempts + 1):
            started = time.monotonic()
            try:
                resp = self.provider.complete(
                    model=model,
                    system=req.system,
                    user=req.user,
                    schema=schema,
                    schema_name=req.schema_name,
                    temperature=temperature,
                    max_output_tokens=req.max_output_tokens,
                    timeout=self.settings.llm_timeout_seconds,
                )
                resp.__dict__["_latency_ms"] = int((time.monotonic() - started) * 1000)
                if resp.finish_reason == "length":
                    raise LlmError("provider answer truncated (max_output_tokens too small)")
                return resp
            except LlmRetryableError as exc:
                last_error = exc
                time.sleep(min(30.0, 2.0**attempt))
        raise LlmError(
            f"provider failed after {self.settings.llm_max_attempts} attempts: {last_error}"
        )

"""Application settings (environment variables with the TRACEPOINT_ prefix, optional .env)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from functools import lru_cache
from pathlib import Path

from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings, SettingsConfigDict

REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]


class Settings(BaseSettings):
    model_config = SettingsConfigDict(
        env_prefix="TRACEPOINT_",
        env_file=(REPO_ROOT / ".env", REPO_ROOT / "backend" / ".env"),
        env_file_encoding="utf-8",
        extra="ignore",
    )

    database_url: str = "REDACTED"
    test_database_url: str = (
        "REDACTED"
    )

    docs_dir: Path = REPO_ROOT / "docs"
    config_dir: Path = REPO_ROOT / "config"
    data_dir: Path = REPO_ROOT / "data"

    # LLM / embedding provider settings. The team will provide the values in a later step;
    # nothing in Phase 1 ingestion calls an external API.
    llm_provider: str = "openai"
    openai_api_key: str | None = None
    openai_base_url: str | None = None
    openai_model: str = ""  # reasoning jobs (findings narration, requirements, challenges)
    openai_model_bulk: str = (
        ""  # bulk jobs (classification, segmentation); falls back to openai_model
    )
    embedding_model: str = ""
    llm_max_cost_usd_per_run: float = 25.0
    llm_concurrency: int = 4
    llm_timeout_seconds: float = 120.0
    llm_max_attempts: int = 4
    llm_temperature: float = 0.0

    # Default human actor for audit events created through the CLI / API.
    human_actor_id: str = "pm"


@lru_cache
def get_settings() -> Settings:
    return Settings()

from __future__ import annotations

from functools import lru_cache
from pathlib import Path

from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings, SettingsConfigDict

REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]


class Settings(BaseSettings):
    model_config = SettingsConfigDict(
        env_prefix="TRACEPOINT_",
        env_file=(REPO_ROOT / ".env", REPO_ROOT / "backend" / ".env"),
        env_file_encoding="utf-8",
        extra="ignore",
    )

.PHONY: start setup db-start db-create db-init db-reset ingest test lint format api audit-export status

BACKEND=backend
UV=cd $(BACKEND) && uv

start:            ## one-shot local start (Docker PostgreSQL, ingestion, findings, reports, tests)
	./start.sh

status:           ## table counts and last runs
	$(UV) run tracepoint status

setup:            ## install the backend with its dev dependencies
	$(UV) sync --all-groups

db-start:         ## start the local PostgreSQL 16 cluster (development container)
	pg_ctlcluster 16 main start || true

db-create:        ## create the application role and databases (idempotent, needs postgres superuser)
	su postgres -c "psql -tAc \"SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='tracepoint'\"" | grep -q 1 || \
	  su postgres -c "psql -c \"CREATE ROLE tracepoint LOGIN PASSWORD 'tracepoint' CREATEDB\""
	for db in tracepoint tracepoint_test; do \
	  su postgres -c "psql -tAc \"SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname='$$db'\"" | grep -q 1 || \
	  su postgres -c "createdb -O tracepoint $$db"; done

db-init:          ## create the schema in the application database
	$(UV) run tracepoint db init

db-reset:         ## drop and recreate the schema
	$(UV) run tracepoint db reset --yes

ingest:           ## ingest all internal files from docs/
	$(UV) run tracepoint ingest all

test:             ## run the test suite (uses the test database)
	$(UV) run pytest -q

lint:             ## lint and check formatting
	$(UV) run ruff check . && $(UV) run ruff format --check .

format:           ## format the code
	$(UV) run ruff format .

api:              ## run the API locally
	$(UV) run uvicorn tracepoint.api.app:app --reload --port 8000

audit-export:     ## export the audit log as JSON to data/exports/
	$(UV) run tracepoint audit export --format json --out ../data/exports/audit_events.json

1	"""Context packs: compact, prompt-sized summaries per vehicle × market for the agents (WP1.9).
2	
3	A pack is a projection of the baseline report plus the strongest findings. It is rebuilt on
4	demand (a few seconds per pack), so there is no cache invalidation to get wrong; the version
5	string changes whenever the structure changes.
6	"""
7	
8	from __future__ import annotations
9	
10	import json
11	from datetime import UTC, datetime
12	from typing import Any
13	
14	from sqlalchemy import case, select
15	from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
16	
17	from tracepoint.db.models import Finding
18	from tracepoint.reports.baseline import build_baseline
19	
20	CONTEXT_PACK_VERSION = "context-pack-v1"
21	_LEVEL_ORDER = case({"A": 0, "B": 1, "C": 2}, value=Finding.evidence_level, else_=3)
22	
23	
24	def _quotes(rows: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
25	    return [
26	        {
27	            "evidence_ref": q["evidence_ref"],
28	            "powertrain": q["powertrain"],
29	            "text": q["text"] if len(q["text"]) <= 300 else q["text"][:300] + " …",
30	        }
31	        for q in rows
32	    ]
33	
34	
35	def _metric(m: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
36	    return {k: m[k] for k in ("attribute", "domain", "score", "scale", "evidence_ref")}
37	
38	
39	def build_context_pack(
40	    session: Session, vehicle_code: str, market_code: str | None, *, top: int = 8
41	) -> dict[str, Any]:
42	    rep = build_baseline(session, vehicle_code, market_code)
43	    stmt = select(Finding).where(
44	        Finding.vehicle_code == vehicle_code, Finding.status != "withdrawn"
45	    )
46	    if market_code:
47	        stmt = stmt.where(Finding.market_code == market_code)
48	    findings = session.scalars(
49	        stmt.order_by(_LEVEL_ORDER, Finding.severity_score.desc().nulls_last(), Finding.id).limit(
50	            15
51	        )
52	    ).all()
53	    cov = rep["coverage"]
54	    return {
55	        "pack": CONTEXT_PACK_VERSION,
56	        "generated_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
57	        "vehicle": rep["vehicle"],
58	        "market": rep["market"],
59	        "coverage": {
60	            k: cov[k] for k in ("verbatims", "by_source", "by_powertrain", "by_feedback_type")
61	        },
62	        "domains": [
63	            {k: d[k] for k in ("domain", "name", "rows", "likes", "complaints", "complaint_share")}
64	            for d in rep["domains"]
65	        ],
66	        "top_complaints": [
67	            {
68	                **{
69	                    k: r[k]
70	                    for k in (
71	                        "theme",
72	                        "domain",
73	                        "complaints",
74	                        "defects",
75	                        "difficult_to_use",
76	                        "wants",
77	                    )
78	                },
79	                "quotes": _quotes(r["quotes"]),
80	            }
81	            for r in rep["top_complaint_themes"][:top]
82	        ],
83	        "top_strengths": [
84	            {
85	                "theme": r["theme"],
86	                "domain": r["domain"],
87	                "likes": r["likes"],
88	                "quotes": _quotes(r["quotes"]),
89	            }
90	            for r in rep["top_strength_themes"][: top // 2 + 1]
91	        ],
92	        "studies": [
93	            {
94	                "study": s["study"],
95	                "weakest": [_metric(m) for m in s["weakest"][:5]],
96	                "strongest": [_metric(m) for m in s["strongest"][:5]],
97	            }
98	            for s in rep["studies"]
99	        ],
100	        "equipment": {
101	            "catalogue": rep["equipment"]["catalogue"],
102	            "variants": rep["equipment"]["variants"],
103	            "optional_on_all_variants": rep["equipment"]["optional_on_all_variants"][:10],
104	        },
105	        "sales": rep["sales"],
106	        "findings": [
107	            {
108	                "id": f.id,
109	                "kind": f.kind,
110	                "layer": f.layer,
111	                "domain": f.domain_key,
112	                "title": f.title,
113	                "evidence_level": f.evidence_level,
114	                "evidence_count": f.evidence_count,
115	            }
116	            for f in findings
117	        ],
118	    }
119	
120	
121	def render_markdown(pack: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
122	    v = pack["vehicle"]
123	    out = [
124	        f"# Context pack – {v['name']} ({v['code']}), market {pack['market']}",
125	        f"{pack['pack']}, generated {pack['generated_at']}. "
126	        f"Verbatims: {pack['coverage']['verbatims']}.",
127	        "",
128	        "## Domains (complaint share of classified rows)",
129	    ]
130	    for d in pack["domains"]:
131	        share = "–" if d["complaint_share"] is None else f"{d['complaint_share']:.0%}"
132	        out.append(f"- {d['name']}: {d['complaints']} complaints, {d['likes']} likes ({share})")
133	    out += ["", "## Top complaint themes"]
134	    for t in pack["top_complaints"]:
135	        out.append(
136	            f"- **{t['theme']}** ({t['domain']}): {t['complaints']} complaints "
137	            f"(defect {t['defects']}, difficult {t['difficult_to_use']}, wants {t['wants']})"
138	        )
139	        out += [f'  - "{q["text"]}" [{q["evidence_ref"]}]' for q in t["quotes"]]
140	    out += ["", "## Top strengths"]
141	    for t in pack["top_strengths"]:
142	        out.append(f"- **{t['theme']}** ({t['domain']}): {t['likes']} likes")
143	        out += [f'  - "{q["text"]}" [{q["evidence_ref"]}]' for q in t["quotes"][:1]]
144	    for s in pack["studies"]:
145	        out += ["", f"## Study {s['study']}"]
146	        out.append("Weakest: " + "; ".join(f"{m['attribute']} {m['score']}" for m in s["weakest"]))
147	        out.append(
148	            "Strongest: " + "; ".join(f"{m['attribute']} {m['score']}" for m in s["strongest"])
149	        )
150	    out += ["", "## Equipment optional on every variant (Germany catalogue)"]
151	    out += [
152	        f"- {e['item']} ({e['price_eur']:.0f} EUR) [{e['evidence_ref']}]"
153	        for e in pack["equipment"]["optional_on_all_variants"]
154	    ]
155	    out += ["", "## Sales (units)", "```", json.dumps(pack["sales"]["by_year"]), "```"]
156	    out += ["", "## Strongest findings"]
157	    out += [
158	        f"- [{f['evidence_level']}] {f['title']} ({f['kind']}, {f['evidence_count']} evidence) `{f['id']}`"
159	        for f in pack["findings"]
160	    ]
161	    return "\n".join(out) + "\n"
162

"""Engine and session helpers."""

from __future__ import annotations

from sqlalchemy import Engine, create_engine, text
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session, sessionmaker

from tracepoint.core.settings import get_settings
from tracepoint.db.models import Base


def make_engine(url: str | None = None) -> Engine:
    return create_engine(url or get_settings().database_url, future=True)


def make_session_factory(engine: Engine) -> sessionmaker[Session]:
    return sessionmaker(bind=engine, expire_on_commit=False)


FTS_INDEX_SQL = (
    "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_verbatim_fts ON verbatim "
    "USING GIN (to_tsvector('english', text))"
)


def init_schema(engine: Engine) -> None:
    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
    with engine.begin() as conn:
        conn.execute(text(FTS_INDEX_SQL))


def drop_schema(engine: Engine) -> None:
    Base.metadata.drop_all(engine)

import json, time
from sqlalchemy import text
from pydantic import BaseModel
from tracepoint.db.session import make_engine, make_session_factory
from tracepoint.agent.tools import call_tool, tool_schemas
from tracepoint.llm.gateway import LlmGateway, LlmRequest, make_provider

S = make_session_factory(make_engine())
with S() as s:
    for t in ("requirement", "requirement_finding", "verbatim_segment", "llm_call"):
        print(t, s.execute(text(f"select count(*) from {t}")).scalar())
    print(s.execute(text("select vehicle_code, market_code, count(*) from finding where status!='withdrawn' group by 1,2 order by 1,2")).all())
    print(s.execute(text("select vehicle_code, market_code, status, count(*) from requirement group by 1,2,3 order by 1,2")).all())
    print(s.execute(text("select origin, status, count(*) from verbatim_classification group by 1,2 order by 1,2")).all())
    print(s.execute(text("select vehicle_code, market_code, count(*) from verbatim group by 1,2 order by 1,2")).all())
    calls = [
        ("get_context_pack", {"vehicle": "G60", "market": "US"}),
        ("search_evidence", {"query": "charging port flap stuck cold", "vehicle": "G60", "limit": 3}),
        ("get_verbatims_by_theme", {"vehicle": "G60", "theme": "Electric Range", "market": "US", "limit": 2}),
        ("get_metric", {"vehicle": "G60", "market": "US", "attribute": "seat"}),
        ("get_equipment", {"vehicle": "G60", "query": "sitz", "limit": 3}),
        ("get_sales", {"vehicle": "G60"}),
        ("get_findings", {"vehicle": "G60", "market": "US", "limit": 3}),
        ("get_requirements", {"vehicle": "G60", "market": "US"}),
    ]
    for name, args in calls:
        t = time.monotonic()
        r = call_tool(s, name, args, actor_id="agent:smoke")
        print(f"{name:24s} {int((time.monotonic()-t)*1000):5d} ms  {len(json.dumps(r, default=str)):7d} chars  total={r.get('total')} items={len(r.get('items', r.get('findings', [])))}")
    print("schemas:", [x["name"] for x in tool_schemas()])

    # live provider check through the gateway: plain text, then strict structured output
    class Ping(BaseModel):
        ok: bool
        word: str
    gw = LlmGateway(s, make_provider(), run_id=None)
    for tier in ("bulk", "reasoning"):
        try:
            r = gw.complete(LlmRequest(purpose="readiness.ping", system="Answer in JSON.", user="Set ok true and word to 'ready'.", prompt_version="ping-v1", tier=tier, max_output_tokens=200), Ping, use_cache=False)
            print(tier, "OK", r.model, r.parsed, "in", r.input_tokens, "out", r.output_tokens, "usd", r.cost_estimate_usd)
        except Exception as e:
            print(tier, "FAIL", type(e).__name__, str(e)[:600])
    s.rollback()
EOF

## Akış (plana göre)
Ingestion → gap classification → findings (katman bazlı) → G1 → requirements → G2 → scoring/weights → G3 → domain/horizon kararları → G4 release → audit/export.

## Yapılmış, doğrulandı
- **Ingestion:** 8 dosya DB'de. 10.128 verbatim, 18.204 classification, 391 study metric, 463 equipment item, 36 sales satırı.
- **Gap classification:** 2.482 unclassified verbatim etiketli (4.433 label). LLM değil, offline yazılmış `config/classifications/*.jsonl` import'u.
- **Findings:** 653 adet, deterministic SQL, LLM yok. Kapsam: G60 US 226, G70 US 269, F70 EU 123, G60 EU 35.
- **Requirements:** 57 adet (G60 US 20, G70 US 19, F70 EU 18), hepsi `proposed`. Yine offline YAML import'u.
- **G2 gate:** CLI + `POST /requirements/{id}/decision` var, henüz karar kaydı yok.
- **Agent tool'ları:** 8 tool canlı DB'de çalıştı, en yavaşı `get_context_pack` 215 ms. Her çağrı audit event yazıyor.
- **LLM gateway:** iki modele canlı ping attım, ikisi de strict JSON döndü (`gpt-5.4-mini`, `gpt-5.4`). Maliyet ~0,0005 USD, rollback edildi.
- **Testler:** 43 passed.

## Agent için eksik
1. **Agent loop yok.** `gateway.complete()` tek system + user mesajı alıyor; `tools=` parametresi, `tool_calls` işleme ve multi-turn mesaj yok. `call_tool` "agent loop kullanır" diyor ama onu çağıran kod yok.
2. **Soru endpoint'i yok.** `POST /agent/tools/{name}` sadece tek tool çalıştırıyor; `agent ask` benzeri bir giriş yok.
3. **Finding detay tool'u yok.** `get_findings` evidence ve link'ler için HTTP route'una yönlendiriyor; agent finding → evidence zincirini izleyemez.
4. **`max_output_tokens` default 1024.** Uzun analizde cevap kesilir ve gateway `LlmError` fırlatır.
5. **Tool'lar read-only.** Agent finding veya requirement yazamaz.

## Pipeline'da eksik
- **Phase 1 açıkları:** blind validation koşulmadı (key artık var, `classify validate --vehicle G60 --limit 50` çalıştırılabilir). Source B segmentation yapılmadı (0 segment).
- **Phase 2 (external evidence):** sıfır kod. Competitor, regional statistics, trend yok; CN için verbatim yok.
- **Phase 3:** finding metinleri template; LLM narration, linker agent ve G1 gate yok.
- **Phase 4:** G60 EU, CN ve RoW için requirement yok; scope'lar arası consolidation yok.
- **Phase 5:** scoring yok, `priority_score` boş, weight profile yok, G3 yok.
- **Diğer:** G4 release, challenge agent, variation/estimation agent, XLSX export yok.

## Not
5 dosyalık uncommitted diff duruyor (`base_url` fix, snapshot pricing, `.env.example`). Testler bu diff ile geçiyor.

## Öneri
Sıradaki iş agent loop: gateway'e messages + tool-calling, `call_tool` üzerinden döngü (max step, evidence ref'li final cevap), `agent ask` CLI + endpoint, bir de `get_finding` tool'u. Bu bitince "G60 US genel analiz" sorusu mevcut veriyle cevaplanır.

from collections import Counter
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy import delete, select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from tracepoint.classify.prompts import SEG_PROMPT_VERSION, seg_system_prompt, seg_user_prompt

from tracepoint.core.audit import record_event
from tracepoint.db.models import Run, Verbatim, VerbatimSegment
from tracepoint.llm.gateway import LlmGateway, LlmRequest
from tracepoint.llm.pricing import estimate_tokens

ACTOR = "agent:segmenter"
LONG_TEXT = 600


def select_targets(session: Session, vehicle_code: str, limit: int | None = None) -> list[Verbatim]:
    done = select(VerbatimSegment.verbatim_id)
    stmt = (
        select(Verbatim)
        .where(
            Verbatim.vehicle_code == vehicle_code,
            Verbatim.id.notin_(done),
            (Verbatim.source_label == "Source B") | (Verbatim.char_len >= LONG_TEXT),
        )
        .order_by(Verbatim.id)
    )
    if limit:
        stmt = stmt.limit(limit)
    return list(session.scalars(stmt))


def build_request(verbatim: Verbatim) -> LlmRequest:
    return LlmRequest(
        purpose="source_b_segmentation",
        system=seg_system_prompt(),
        user=seg_user_prompt(verbatim.text),
        prompt_version=SEG_PROMPT_VERSION,
        schema_name="segmentation",
        tier="bulk",
        max_output_tokens=1200,
        metadata={"verbatim_id": verbatim.id},
    )


def run_segmentation(
    session: Session,
    run: Run,
    vehicle_code: str,
    gateway: LlmGateway | None,
    *,
    limit: int | None = None,
    dry_run: bool = False,
    batch_size: int = 50,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    targets = select_targets(session, vehicle_code, limit)
    stats: Counter = Counter({"targets": len(targets)})
    if dry_run or gateway is None:
        sys_tokens = estimate_tokens(seg_system_prompt())
        stats["total_input_tokens_est"] = sum(
            sys_tokens + estimate_tokens(v.text) + 20 for v in targets
        )
        record_event(
            session,
            actor_type="agent",
            actor_id=ACTOR,
            action="segmentation.dry_run",
            entity_type="vehicle",
            entity_id=vehicle_code,
            run_id=run.id,

content.text:
Source B = çağrı merkezi (customer relations) notları. Müşteri yazmamış, temsilci yazmış: "Customer stated…", "Writer advised…". Sadece G60 (2.626) ve G70 (2.853) için var, toplam 5.479 verbatim — tüm verinin yarısından fazlası.

**Sorun:** her not iki şeyi karıştırıyor.
- Ürün geri bildirimi: müşteri neyi beğenmiş, neyi eksik bulmuş, ne bozuk.
- Süreç içeriği: temsilcinin verdiği talimat, bayi randevusu, çağrı akışı.

DB'den örnek: müşteri "traffic light warning" özelliğini satın almış, uyarı gelmiyor (ürün). Devamı "Writer instructed the customer to select update apps and services…" (süreç).

**Segmentation ne yapar:** notu sıralı parçalara böler, her parçaya `is_product_feedback` true/false + kısa gerekçe verir. Metin aynen korunur, paraphrase yok. Sonuç `verbatim_segment` tablosuna yazılır.

Hedef kümesi Source B + diğer kaynaklardaki 600 karakterden uzun metinler (`classify/segment.py:29`). Verbatim başına bir LLM çağrısı, `bulk` tier.

**Durum:** kod, prompt ve şema hazır (`tracepoint classify segments --vehicle G60`), ama hiç koşulmadı; tabloda 0 satır.

**Şu an etkisi düşük:** segment'leri okuyan hiçbir kod yok. Findings, context pack ve tool'lar tam verbatim metnini kullanıyor. Koşulursa kazanç:
- Alıntılarda temsilci cümleleri ve bayi detayları çıkar, sadece müşteri sözü kalır.
- Agent'a giden metin kısalır.

**Maliyet:** rapordaki dry-run'a göre G60 için ~0,6M input token; `gpt-5.4-mini` ile G60 + G70 toplamı birkaç dolar.

Öncelik değil. Önce agent loop; segmentation ancak alıntı kalitesi sorun olursa, ve o zaman `search_evidence` / context pack'in segment'leri okuması da gerekir.

"""Registry of the internal input files and their evidence sources."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from tracepoint.core.audit import record_event
from tracepoint.core.settings import REPO_ROOT, get_settings
from tracepoint.db.models import Run, Source


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class InternalFile:
    key: str
    filename: str
    fmt: str
    layer: str
    description: str
    vehicle_code: str | None = None


INTERNAL_FILES: dict[str, InternalFile] = {
    "feedback_f70": InternalFile(
        "feedback_f70",
        "F70_feedback_hackathon.xlsx",
        "xlsx",
        "voice_of_customer",
        "Customer verbatims BMW 1 Series (F70) with VFC classification",
        "F70",
    ),
    "feedback_g60": InternalFile(
        "feedback_g60",
        "G60_feedback_hackathon.xlsx",
        "xlsx",
        "voice_of_customer",
        "Customer verbatims BMW 5 Series (G60) with VFC classification",
        "G60",
    ),
    "feedback_g70": InternalFile(
        "feedback_g70",
        "G70_feedback_hackathon.xlsx",
        "xlsx",
        "voice_of_customer",
        "Customer verbatims BMW 7 Series (G70) with VFC classification",
        "G70",
    ),
    "studies": InternalFile(
        "studies",
        "F70_G60_G68_G70_customer_studies.xlsx",
        "xlsx",
        "quantitative_metrics",
        "Customer studies: CN/EU 2025 attribute means and US 2025 rating distributions",
    ),
    "sales": InternalFile(
        "sales",
        "sales_volumes.xlsx",
        "xlsx",
        "portfolio_offering",
        "Sales volumes by market: 2024, 2025 actual and 2030 forecast",
    ),
    "optionlist_f70": InternalFile(
        "optionlist_f70",
        "F70_OptionList.PDF",
        "pdf",
        "portfolio_offering",
        "German price and equipment catalogue BMW 1 Series (July 2026)",
        "F70",
    ),
    "optionlist_g60": InternalFile(
        "optionlist_g60",
        "G60_OptionList.PDF",
        "pdf",
        "portfolio_offering",
        "German price and equipment catalogue BMW 5 Series Sedan (July 2026)",
        "G60",
    ),
    "optionlist_g70": InternalFile(
        "optionlist_g70",
        "G70_OptionList.PDF",
        "pdf",
        "portfolio_offering",
        "German price and equipment catalogue BMW 7 Series (July 2026)",
        "G70",
    ),
}


def source_id_for(key: str) -> str:
    return "SRC-" + key.upper().replace("_", "-")


def file_path(key: str) -> Path:
    return get_settings().docs_dir / INTERNAL_FILES[key].filename


def sha256_of(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as fh:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: fh.read(1 << 20), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def _display_path(path: Path) -> str:
    try:
        return str(path.relative_to(REPO_ROOT))
    except ValueError:
        return str(path)


def register_source(session: Session, run: Run, key: str) -> Source:
    """Create or refresh the Source row for an internal file (checksum, size, timestamp)."""
    spec = INTERNAL_FILES[key]
    path = file_path(key)
    if not path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(path)
    checksum = sha256_of(path)
    size = path.stat().st_size
    sid = source_id_for(key)
    src = session.get(Source, sid)
    now = datetime.now(UTC)
    if src is None:
        src = Source(
            id=sid,
            kind="internal_file",
            name=spec.description,
            path_or_url=_display_path(path),
            format=spec.fmt,
            layer=spec.layer,
            checksum=checksum,
            size_bytes=size,
            fetched_at=now,
            reliability="internal",
            notes=f"vehicle={spec.vehicle_code}" if spec.vehicle_code else None,
            created_run_id=run.id,
        )
        session.add(src)
        session.flush()
        record_event(
            session,
            actor_type="system",
            actor_id="ingest.registry",
            action="source.registered",
            entity_type="source",
            entity_id=sid,
            run_id=run.id,
            after={"path": src.path_or_url, "checksum": checksum, "size_bytes": size},
        )
    elif src.checksum != checksum:
        before = {"checksum": src.checksum, "size_bytes": src.size_bytes}
        src.checksum = checksum
        src.size_bytes = size
        src.fetched_at = now
        record_event(
            session,
            actor_type="system",
            actor_id="ingest.registry",
            action="source.updated",
            entity_type="source",
            entity_id=sid,
            run_id=run.id,
            before=before,
            after={"checksum": checksum, "size_bytes": size},
            rationale="Input file content changed since the previous registration",
        )
    return src
"""SQLAlchemy models for the Tracepoint evidence store (Phase 1 subset).

Every evidence row carries a source reference, a locator back to the original file position and
the run that created it. Identifiers are stable and human-readable (see core.ids).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime
from decimal import Decimal
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy import (
    BigInteger,
    Boolean,
    DateTime,
    Float,
    ForeignKey,
    Integer,
    LargeBinary,
    Numeric,
    String,
    Text,
    UniqueConstraint,
)
from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import JSONB
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, Mapped, mapped_column, relationship


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Reference data
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


class Vehicle(Base):
    __tablename__ = "vehicle"

    code: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(8), primary_key=True)
    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(80))
    series: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(40))
    generation: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(80))
    segment: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(80))
    tier: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(40))
    notes: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text)

    variants: Mapped[list[VehicleVariant]] = relationship(back_populates="vehicle")


class VehicleVariant(Base):
    __tablename__ = "vehicle_variant"

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), primary_key=True)
    vehicle_code: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(ForeignKey("vehicle.code"))
    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(80))
    powertrain: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(16))  # ICE / MHEV / PHEV / BEV
    fuel: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(16))  # petrol / diesel / electric
    drive: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(16))  # front / rear / all-wheel
    power_kw: Mapped[int | None] = mapped_column(Integer)
    base_price_eur: Mapped[Decimal | None] = mapped_column(Numeric(12, 2))
    column_order: Mapped[int | None] = mapped_column(Integer)
    source_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(ForeignKey("source.id"))
    locator: Mapped[dict[str, Any] | None] = mapped_column(JSONB)
    created_run_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(ForeignKey("run.id"))

    vehicle: Mapped[Vehicle] = relationship(back_populates="variants")


class Market(Base):
    __tablename__ = "market"

    code: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(8), primary_key=True)
    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(80))
    notes: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text)


class Country(Base):
    __tablename__ = "country"

    code: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(2), primary_key=True)
    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(80))
    market_code: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(ForeignKey("market.code"))


class Source(Base):
    __tablename__ = "source"

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), primary_key=True)
    kind: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(32))  # internal_file / web_page / manual
    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(200))
    path_or_url: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(Text)
    format: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(32))
    layer: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(40))
    checksum: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(80))
    size_bytes: Mapped[int | None] = mapped_column(BigInteger)
    fetched_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True))
    reliability: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(40))
    notes: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text)
    created_run_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(ForeignKey("run.id"))


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Taxonomy (canonical VFC lists)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


class TaxonomyLevel2(Base):
    __tablename__ = "taxonomy_level2"

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(16), primary_key=True)
    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(200), unique=True)
    domain_key: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(40))
    origin: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(16), default="given")  # given / proposed
    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(16), default="canonical")
    notes: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text)


class TaxonomyLevel3(Base):
    __tablename__ = "taxonomy_level3"

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(16), primary_key=True)
    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(200), unique=True)

        String(16)
    )  # positive / negative / request / neutral
    origin: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(16), default="given")
    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(16), default="canonical")
    notes: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Evidence: verbatims
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

from __future__ import annotations

import openpyxl
from sqlalchemy import delete
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from tracepoint.core.audit import record_event
from tracepoint.db.models import Run, SalesVolume
from tracepoint.ingest.registry import file_path, register_source

SHEET_TO_VEHICLE = {
    "F70": ("F70", None),
    "G60_G68": (
        "G60",
        "Sheet G60_G68 reports the combined volume of G60 and G68 (China long-wheelbase); the G68 share is not given (assumption D-015 area)",
    ),
    "G70": ("G70", None),
}
FORECAST_YEARS = {2030}


def ingest_sales(session: Session, run: Run) -> dict[str, int]:
    source = register_source(session, run, "sales")
    path = file_path("sales")
    session.execute(delete(SalesVolume))
    wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(path, read_only=True, data_only=True)
    rows_out: list[SalesVolume] = []
    for ws in wb.worksheets:
        if ws.title not in SHEET_TO_VEHICLE:
            continue
        vehicle, note = SHEET_TO_VEHICLE[ws.title]
        rows = list(ws.iter_rows(values_only=True))
        header = [str(h).strip() if h is not None else "" for h in rows[0]]
        year_cols = {
            i: int(h.split("_")[1]) for i, h in enumerate(header) if h.startswith("volume_")
        }
        code_col = header.index("market_code")
        for r_idx, row in enumerate(rows[1:], start=2):
            market = str(row[code_col]).strip()
            for col, year in year_cols.items():
                units = int(float(row[col]))
                rows_out.append(
                    SalesVolume(
                        id=f"SAL-{vehicle}-{market}-{year}",
                        vehicle_code=vehicle,
                        market_code=market,
                        year=year,
                        units=units,
                        kind="forecast" if year in FORECAST_YEARS else "actual",
                        note=note,
                        source_id=source.id,
                        locator={"sheet": ws.title, "row": r_idx, "col": col + 1},
                        created_run_id=run.id,
                    )
                )
    session.add_all(rows_out)
    session.flush()
    stats = {"rows": len(rows_out), "sheets": len(SHEET_TO_VEHICLE)}
    record_event(
        session,
        actor_type="system",
        actor_id="ingest.sales",
        action="sales.ingested",
        entity_type="source",
        entity_id=source.id,
        run_id=run.id,
        after=stats,
        rationale=f"Parsed {path.name}; sheet G60_G68 attached to G60 with a combined-volume note",
    )
    return stats

def source_id_for(key: str) -> str:
    return "SRC-" + key.upper().replace("_", "-")


def file_path(key: str) -> Path:
    return get_settings().docs_dir / INTERNAL_FILES[key].filename


def sha256_of(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as fh:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: fh.read(1 << 20), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def _display_path(path: Path) -> str:
    try:
        return str(path.relative_to(REPO_ROOT))
    except ValueError:
        return str(path)


def register_source(session: Session, run: Run, key: str) -> Source:
    """Create or refresh the Source row for an internal file (checksum, size, timestamp)."""
    spec = INTERNAL_FILES[key]
    path = file_path(key)
    if not path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(path)
    checksum = sha256_of(path)
    size = path.stat().st_size
    sid = source_id_for(key)
    src = session.get(Source, sid)
    now = datetime.now(UTC)
    if src is None:
        src = Source(
            id=sid,
            kind="internal_file",
            name=spec.description,
            path_or_url=_display_path(path),
            format=spec.fmt,
            layer=spec.layer,
            checksum=checksum,
            size_bytes=size,
            fetched_at=now,
            reliability="internal",
            notes=f"vehicle={spec.vehicle_code}" if spec.vehicle_code else None,
            created_run_id=run.id,
        )
        session.add(src)
        session.flush()
        record_event(
            session,
            actor_type="system",
            actor_id="ingest.registry",
            action="source.registered",
            entity_type="source",
            entity_id=sid,
            run_id=run.id,
            after={"path": src.path_or_url, "checksum": checksum, "size_bytes": size},
        )
    elif src.checksum != checksum:
        before = {"checksum": src.checksum, "size_bytes": src.size_bytes}
        src.checksum = checksum
        src.size_bytes = size
        src.fetched_at = now
        record_event(
            session,
            actor_type="system",
            actor_id="ingest.registry",
            action="source.updated",
            entity_type="source",
            entity_id=sid,
            run_id=run.id,
            before=before,
            after={"checksum": checksum, "size_bytes": size},
            rationale="Input file content changed since the previous registration",
        )
    return src
"""SQLAlchemy models for the Tracepoint evidence store (Phase 1 subset).

Every evidence row carries a source reference, a locator back to the original file position and
the run that created it. Identifiers are stable and human-readable (see core.ids).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime
from decimal import Decimal
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy import (
    BigInteger,
    Boolean,
    DateTime,
    Float,
    ForeignKey,
    Integer,
    LargeBinary,
    Numeric,
    String,
    Text,
    UniqueConstraint,
)
from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import JSONB
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, Mapped, mapped_column, relationship


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Reference data
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


class Vehicle(Base):
    __tablename__ = "vehicle"

    code: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(8), primary_key=True)
    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(80))
    series: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(40))
    generation: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(80))
    segment: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(80))
    tier: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(40))
    notes: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text)

    variants: Mapped[list[VehicleVariant]] = relationship(back_populates="vehicle")


class VehicleVariant(Base):
    __tablename__ = "vehicle_variant"

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), primary_key=True)
    vehicle_code: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(ForeignKey("vehicle.code"))
    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(80))
    powertrain: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(16))  # ICE / MHEV / PHEV / BEV
    fuel: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(16))  # petrol / diesel / electric
    drive: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(16))  # front / rear / all-wheel
    power_kw: Mapped[int | None] = mapped_column(Integer)
    base_price_eur: Mapped[Decimal | None] = mapped_column(Numeric(12, 2))
    column_order: Mapped[int | None] = mapped_column(Integer)
    source_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(ForeignKey("source.id"))
    locator: Mapped[dict[str, Any] | None] = mapped_column(JSONB)
    created_run_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(ForeignKey("run.id"))

    vehicle: Mapped[Vehicle] = relationship(back_populates="variants")


class Market(Base):
    __tablename__ = "market"

    code: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(8), primary_key=True)
    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(80))
    notes: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text)


class Country(Base):
    __tablename__ = "country"

    code: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(2), primary_key=True)
    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(80))
    market_code: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(ForeignKey("market.code"))


class Source(Base):
    __tablename__ = "source"

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), primary_key=True)
    kind: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(32))  # internal_file / web_page / manual
    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(200))
    path_or_url: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(Text)
    format: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(32))
    layer: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(40))
    checksum: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(80))
    size_bytes: Mapped[int | None] = mapped_column(BigInteger)
    fetched_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True))
    reliability: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(40))
    notes: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text)
    created_run_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(ForeignKey("run.id"))


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Taxonomy (canonical VFC lists)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


class TaxonomyLevel2(Base):
    __tablename__ = "taxonomy_level2"

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(16), primary_key=True)
    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(200), unique=True)
    domain_key: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(40))
    origin: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(16), default="given")  # given / proposed
    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(16), default="canonical")
    notes: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text)


class TaxonomyLevel3(Base):

    notes: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text)

from __future__ import annotations

SHEET_TO_VEHICLE = {
    "F70": ("F70", None),
    "G60_G68": (
        "G60",
        "Sheet G60_G68 reports the combined volume of G60 and G68 (China long-wheelbase); the G68 share is not given (assumption D-015 area)",
    ),
    "G70": ("G70", None),
}
FORECAST_YEARS = {2030}


def ingest_sales(session: Session, run: Run) -> dict[str, int]:
    source = register_source(session, run, "sales")
    path = file_path("sales")
    session.execute(delete(SalesVolume))
    wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(path, read_only=True, data_only=True)
    rows_out: list[SalesVolume] = []
    for ws in wb.worksheets:
        if ws.title not in SHEET_TO_VEHICLE:
            continue
        vehicle, note = SHEET_TO_VEHICLE[ws.title]
        rows = list(ws.iter_rows(values_only=True))
        header = [str(h).strip() if h is not None else "" for h in rows[0]]
        year_cols = {
            i: int(h.split("_")[1]) for i, h in enumerate(header) if h.startswith("volume_")
        }
        code_col = header.index("market_code")
        for r_idx, row in enumerate(rows[1:], start=2):
            market = str(row[code_col]).strip()
            for col, year in year_cols.items():
                units = int(float(row[col]))
                rows_out.append(
                    SalesVolume(
                        id=f"SAL-{vehicle}-{market}-{year}",
                        vehicle_code=vehicle,
                        market_code=market,
                        year=year,
                        units=units,
                        kind="forecast" if year in FORECAST_YEARS else "actual",
                        note=note,
                        source_id=source.id,
                        locator={"sheet": ws.title, "row": r_idx, "col": col + 1},
                        created_run_id=run.id,
                    )
                )
    session.add_all(rows_out)
    session.flush()
    stats = {"rows": len(rows_out), "sheets": len(SHEET_TO_VEHICLE)}
    record_event(
        session,
        actor_type="system",
        actor_id="ingest.sales",
        action="sales.ingested",
        entity_type="source",
        entity_id=source.id,
        run_id=run.id,
        after=stats,
        rationale=f"Parsed {path.name}; sheet G60_G68 attached to G60 with a combined-volume note",
    )
    return stats

import sys, pdfplumber

def columns(page, min_gap=9.0, tolerance=0):
    """x-ranges of text columns: vertical bands no word crosses split the page."""
    words = page.extract_words()
    if not words:
        return []
    lo, hi = int(min(w["x0"] for w in words)), int(max(w["x1"] for w in words)) + 1
    cover = [0] * (hi - lo + 1)
    for w in words:
        for x in range(int(w["x0"]) - lo, int(w["x1"]) - lo + 1):
            cover[x] += 1
    cuts, start = [], None
    for i, c in enumerate(cover + [1]):
        if c <= tolerance and start is None:
            start = i
        elif c > tolerance and start is not None:
            if i - start >= min_gap:
                cuts.append(lo + (start + i) / 2)
            start = None
    edges = [page.bbox[0], *cuts, page.bbox[2]]
    return list(zip(edges, edges[1:]))

path='../docs/BMW-Group-Report-2025-en.pdf'
pages=[int(a) for a in sys.argv[1:]]

        print(f'=== p{n} size {p.width:.0f}x{p.height:.0f} cols {[(round(a),round(b)) for a,b in cols]}')

import sys, time, collections, pdfplumber

HEADER_BOTTOM = 60.0
MIN_GAP = 9.0
MIN_COLUMN = 150.0

def column_edges(words, left, right):
    lo, hi = int(min(w["x0"] for w in words)), int(max(w["x1"] for w in words)) + 1
    cover = [False] * (hi - lo + 2)
    for w in words:
        for x in range(int(w["x0"]) - lo, int(w["x1"]) - lo + 1):
            cover[x] = True
    cuts, start = [], None
    for i, c in enumerate(cover):
        if not c and start is None:
            start = i
        elif c and start is not None:
            if i - start >= MIN_GAP:
                cuts.append(lo + (start + i) / 2)
            start = None
    kept = [c for c, nxt in zip(cuts, [*cuts[1:], hi]) if nxt - c >= MIN_COLUMN]
    return [left, *kept, right]

def page_text(page):
    x0, top, x1, bottom = page.bbox
    header = (page.crop((x0, top, x1, top + HEADER_BOTTOM)).extract_text() or "").splitlines()
    body = page.crop((x0, top + HEADER_BOTTOM, x1, bottom))
    words = body.extract_words()
    if not words:
        return header, "", 0
    edges = column_edges(words, x0, x1)
    parts = [body.crop((a, top + HEADER_BOTTOM, b, bottom)).extract_text() or "" for a, b in zip(edges, edges[1:])]
    return header, "\n\n".join(p for p in parts if p.strip()), len(edges) - 1

path='../docs/BMW-Group-Report-2025-en.pdf'
with pdfplumber.open(path) as pdf:
    if sys.argv[1] == 'all':
        t=time.monotonic(); dist=collections.Counter(); heads=collections.Counter(); total=0
        for p in pdf.pages:
            h, tx, n = page_text(p); p.flush_cache(); dist[n]+=1; heads[len(h)]+=1; total+=len(tx)
        print(round(time.monotonic()-t,1),'s', 'cols', sorted(dist.items()), 'header lines', sorted(heads.items()), 'chars', total)
    else:
        for n in map(int, sys.argv[1:]):
            h, tx, c = page_text(pdf.pages[n-1])
            print(f'=== p{n} cols={c} header={[x[:50] for x in h]}\n{tx[:int(1e9)] if False else tx[:1100]}')
EOF

# Findings (Phase 3): layer-specific, quantified signals with linked evidence
`TRACEPOINT_OPENAI_MODEL_BULK` (classification, segmentation); without them use `--dry-run`.

Settings are read from environment variables with the `TRACEPOINT_` prefix or a `.env` file at the
repository root (see `.env.example`).

## Commands

| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `tracepoint db init` / `db reset --yes` | create / recreate the schema |
| `tracepoint taxonomy extract` | extract the canonical VFC lists and apply the authored domain map and polarity rules |
| `tracepoint ingest reference` | load vehicles, markets, countries and the taxonomy from `config/` |
| `tracepoint ingest verbatims` / `studies` / `sales` / `optionlists` / `all` | ingest the input files (idempotent per vehicle) |
| `tracepoint report baseline --vehicle G60 --market US --out-dir ../reports/baseline` | baseline situation-analysis report (Markdown + JSON) |
| `tracepoint audit export --format json\|csv [--out file]` | export the audit event log |
| `tracepoint classify import [--vehicle G60]` | apply the committed gap labels in `config/classifications/<vehicle>_gaps.jsonl` (no API call; also run by `ingest all`) |
| `tracepoint classify gaps --vehicle G60 [--limit N] [--dry-run]` | LLM gap classification of unclassified rows (dry run: prompts and token estimate only) |
| `tracepoint classify segments --vehicle G60 [--dry-run]` | LLM segmentation of Source B notes into product / process statements |
| `tracepoint classify prepare-sample --vehicle G60` | write the blind-validation sample to `config/validation/` |
| `tracepoint classify validate --vehicle G60` | blind re-classification of the sample; writes `reports/validation/` |
| `tracepoint findings extract --vehicle G60 --market US` | deterministic finding extraction (voice of customer, study metrics, equipment gaps, links) |
| `tracepoint findings report --vehicle G60 --market US --out-dir ../reports/findings` | Markdown finding list |
| `tracepoint requirements import` | load `config/requirements/*.yaml` (validated against the findings, versioned, audited) and replay the G2 decisions in `config/decisions/requirements.jsonl` |
| `tracepoint requirements decide REQ-G60-US-IC-01 approve --note "…"` | gate G2 (approve / reject / defer) on the current version; logged and appended to the decisions file. Also `POST /requirements/{id}/decision` |
| `tracepoint requirements export [--vehicle G60 --market US]` | requirement list (deliverable D2) as Markdown and CSV in `data/requirements/`; API `GET /requirements`, `GET /requirements/{id}` (traceability to findings and evidence, event history) |
| `tracepoint agent packs [--vehicle G60]` | context pack (JSON + Markdown) per vehicle × market with evidence, written to `data/context_packs/` |
| `tracepoint agent tools` | tool definitions for an LLM agent (name, description, JSON input schema) |
| `tracepoint agent call search_evidence '{"query": "charging flap", "vehicle": "G60"}'` | run one agent tool; every call is an audit event (`tool.called`). Also over HTTP: `GET /agent/tools`, `POST /agent/tools/{name}` |
| `tracepoint settings` | print the effective settings |

## Layout

```
tracepoint/
  core/       settings, identifiers, audit event log, run registry
  db/         SQLAlchemy models and session helpers
  ingest/     registry of input files, reference loader, parsers (verbatims, studies, sales, option lists)
  taxonomy/   canonical taxonomy extraction and enrichment
  reports/    baseline situation-analysis report
  llm/        provider-agnostic LLM gateway (OpenAI first), pricing, strict JSON schemas
  classify/   gap classification, Source B segmentation, few-shot retrieval, blind validation
  findings/   deterministic finding extraction, cross-layer links, Markdown report
  agent/      context packs and drill-down tools for the agents (logged tool calls)
  requirements/  requirement store (import, versioning, G2 decisions) and D2 exports
  api/        FastAPI read API
  cli.py      Typer command line interface
tests/        pytest suite (ingests docs/ into the test database once per session)
```

## Evidence references

Every evidence row has a `locator` (file, sheet / page, row / position) and a `created_run_id`.
Findings and requirements (later phases) reference evidence with strings such as
`verbatim:G60-0123`, `metric:MET-US-US-G60-voice_recognition`, `equipment:EQ-F70-0112`,
`sales:SAL-G60-US-2030`, `spec:SPEC-G60-i5_edrive40-electric_range_wltp_km`.
```bash
./start.sh            # macOS / Linux / WSL
.\start.ps1           # Windows PowerShell
```

The script starts PostgreSQL 16 in Docker (persistent volume `tracepoint-pgdata`), creates `.env`
from `.env.example`, installs the backend, creates the schema, ingests the eight files under
`docs/`, extracts findings for four vehicle × market scopes, writes fresh reports under `data/reports/` (the committed samples under `reports/` stay
unchanged) and runs the test suite. It is safe to re-run.

| Option | Effect |
|---|---|
| `--reset` / `-Reset` | drop the database volume and rebuild everything |
| `--no-docker` | use a PostgreSQL already running on `localhost:$TRACEPOINT_PG_PORT` (role `tracepoint`, databases `tracepoint` and `tracepoint_test`) |
| `--with-llm` / `-WithLlm` | run a 50-verbatim classifier validation per vehicle (needs the OpenAI key in `.env`) |
| `--llm-full` | full validation, gap classification and segmentation (costs tokens) |
| `--skip-tests` / `-SkipTests` | skip pytest |
| `--api` / `-Api` | start the read API on http://localhost:8000/docs afterwards |

Set `TRACEPOINT_PG_PORT=5433` before starting if port 5432 is taken on your machine.

Podman instead of Docker (e.g. Fedora): `systemctl --user enable --now podman.socket`, then
`export DOCKER_HOST=unix:///run/user/$UID/podman/podman.sock` before `./start.sh`.
